About the Portal

The UET Mardan Student Activities Portal is run by the Directorate of Student Affairs to keep students connected with campus life beyond the classroom. Student societies and clubs at UET Mardan organise technology exhibitions, sports tournaments, cultural festivals, debates and career seminars throughout the semester.

Through this portal, students can browse all upcoming activities, view the complete event schedule with dates, times and venues, and submit the online registration form for the events they want to join — no need to visit the Student Affairs Office in person.

Upcoming Events

Four major activities are lined up this semester. Pick your favourite and register before the seats fill up.

TechFest & Robotics Expo

Final-year and society teams display robotics, IoT and software projects. Includes a robotics competition and a project exhibition judged by faculty and industry guests.

5 Nov 2026 · Main Auditorium

Register
Inter-Department Cricket Tournament

The most loved event of the semester. Department teams face off in knockout cricket matches at the university ground, ending with a trophy and prize distribution ceremony.

12 Nov 2026 · University Cricket Ground

Register
Cultural & Food Festival

A full day of music, drama, traditional dress and food stalls from every region of Pakistan, organised by the Cultural Society in the main ground and amphitheatre.

19 Nov 2026 · Main Ground & Amphitheatre

Register
Career Development Seminar

Industry professionals and UET alumni share guidance on CV writing, internships, freelancing and job interviews, followed by a question and answer session for students.

26 Nov 2026 · Seminar Hall, CS Department
